access_method: H2C/C2H by os.write/os.read on the vendor SGDMA char devices; control only via ioctl ANLOGIC_IOCR (bar_id/bar_offaddr); no BAR offset hardcoded in the host scheduler
address_formula: data path uses the SGDMA h2c_0/c2h_0 char devices (logical frames, driver owns DMA addresses); control path uses ioctl ANLOGIC_IOCR with bar_id+bar_offaddr; user node write offset is +0x80000 and differs from raw BAR offset
data_mode: AXI-ST (H2C x1, C2H x1, 128-bit tdata; TLAST=descriptor EOP)
axist_framing: one logical frame per transfer; H2C 1952B, C2H 1184B (16B-multiples, no partial tailbeat)
dma_alignment: not separately measured; all frames are 16B multiples (1952=122*16, 1184=74*16, 32=2*16)
dma_length_granularity: not separately measured; logical frames used as-is
dma_padding: none added by codec; transport sees exact logical frames only
coherence_sync: handled by the vendor SGDMA driver; not separately measured
submit_order: H2C write first (char-device write submits), then read the C2H frame
write_return_meaning: os.write returns bytes accepted by the SGDMA char device (submission); a short write is a hard error
input_visibility: write() returns after submission; endpoint consumes the frame
request_accepted: no separate accept signal (no status word); proven by a matching C2H response
dma_completion: vendor SGDMA driver poll_mode=1; completion per transfer
attention_completion: not wired yet (no application status word); ATTENTION op not implemented in the current endpoint
stale_done_clear: n/a; single request in flight and seq is validated
readback_consume: C2H frame consumed only after a full read plus CRC/seq/layer/position validation
timeout_handling: one finite monotonic deadline per request; read_exact enforces it via select(); a blocked char-device write cannot be safely cancelled (documented, not retried)
short_io_handling: short write/read raises TransportError; no fragmentation or silent retry
error_recovery: FAULT requires explicit reset; flush_queues() drains the C2H node on recover()
correctness_method: per-round counter, byte-exact payload compare, and CRC/seq/layer/position via the v2 codec
